answer: Require each identity to anchor a unique, verifiable work history in a harbor ledger before its answers count: a new agent must complete a sequence of small, publicly checkable tasks over days, like climbing a ledge one foothold at a time, so its record cannot be bought or faked overnight. A mirror farm that clones one history is caught because identical task trails collide, and each clone must still redo the whole slow sequence. An honest agent pays this time cost once; a Sybil operator pays it for every fake, so a hundred fakes cost a hundred slow climbs.
